body.text: Poetry Roots Goals: Show where the voice comes from. “How does Nas sound wise AND young at the same time?”

body.label: Key points
items: Father Ol’ Man Jones = jazz cornetist → rhythm in his DNA
Dropped out at 13 → studied “the streets” AND libraries
early partner = the brilliant (and doomed) Ill Will

finalProject.prompt: Explain how Nas used poetic lyricism, vivid storytelling, and political consciousness to shape hip-hop. Compare ONE track from Illmatic (‘N.Y. State of Mind’) with ONE track from his mature era (‘One Mic’ or something from King’s Disease), and identify TWO modern artists clearly influenced by Nas.
